english.title: Use / cause / permit a vehicle to be used at Stansted Airport London when the safety locking devices was not in order
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[used a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[caused a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be used]_
(C)_[permitted a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be used]_

**(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) to which the road traffic enactments do not apply at Stansted Airport London when the safety locking devices fitted to the vehicle were not in good working order
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 5(6) and 2(3) of the Stansted Airport - London Byelaws, 1996 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
